visual.general_description: Portrait-orientation anteroposterior radiograph of a hemipelvis and proximal femur showing fracture lines and separated bone fragments in the proximal femoral shaft region.
visual.detailed_description: Unlabelled single radiograph in portrait format. The top shows part of the pelvis with the acetabular region and the femoral head and neck region; the proximal femur runs down the right of the image. Below the greater trochanter region the shaft shows oblique and comminuted fracture lines with a long thin wedge-shaped fragment lying medial to the shaft and a second long fragment overlapping the shaft, plus small bone fragments between them. A graduated ruler with tick marks runs along the bottom edge and a blurred finger-like shadow appears at the bottom left. Partial lettering is cut off at the upper right edge and is not legible. No implant, arrow, panel letter or printed measurement is visible.

visual.general_description: Portrait-orientation radiograph of the proximal femur with a long intramedullary nail and an obliquely directed proximal screw, with fracture fragments visible around the proximal shaft.
visual.detailed_description: Single unlettered post-fixation radiograph. A long straight metallic nail runs down the femoral shaft from its upper end near the pelvis; a threaded screw crosses the nail obliquely and points toward the femoral head region, with a short cross element near the nail at the level of the proximal femur. Several separated bone fragments with irregular margins lie around the upper shaft beside the nail. A white letter L is printed at the right-middle of the image beside a vertical graduated scale labelled 21cm at its lower end. Faint rotated digits are also visible at the upper right but are not legible.
